_comment: POSIX sample MCP client config that launches the pdb2reaction MCP server over stdio. The `mcpServers` schema is the de-facto MCP client convention (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codeium, custom Python / TypeScript clients via the `mcp` SDK). Drop a copy of this object into your POSIX client's config file (e.g. ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json on macOS, ~/.cursor/mcp.json for Cursor, or your custom client's equivalent). Replace `<conda-prefix>/envs/<env-name>` with the conda env that has pdb2reaction installed (the output of `conda info --base` plus `/envs/<your-env>`). For Windows, use the platform-specific snippet in docs/mcp_server.md.
